modules.module_title: Introduction and Prerequisites to Printed Circuit Board Assembly

pcs.pc_description: Describe the role and responsibilities of a Sr. Operator – Pick and Place Assembly; explain the scope of surface mount technology (SMT) in electronics manufacturing and the working principle of Pick and Place machines used for automated, high-speed, and precision mounting of electronic components on PCBs.
Identify daily work requirements, including PCB design specifications, from the supervisor and arrange the required tools for PCB assembly, such as a wire cutter, pliers, and soldering iron.
Collect the PCB board, electronic components, and module software as per the requirement.
Inspect the board and components for any errors and get them rectified/replaced accordingly.
Mount the board on a holder or pallet to insert/install components appropriately
Insert components into designated plated through-holes (PTH) as per the design
Inspect the soldering station before starting work to resolve any potential issues
Solder the components onto the circuit board using the soldering station as per standard operating procedures (SOP).
Analyze the assembled board using a magnifying glass to check for missing components, incorrect values, or dry soldering
Conduct a functional test of the PCB assembly to identify soldering-related errors
Rework to rectify soldering errors or any other identified issues to ensure the board passes the functional test
Maintain documentation of assembled components and deliver the completed board to the device assembly team on time

modules.module_title: Program and Load the Pick-and-Place Machine

pcs.pc_description: Inspect the printed solder paste for consistency and desired accuracy.
Load specified programs on the machine according to the PCB assembly plan
Identify components for assembly and ensure their accurate placement on the reel.
Troubleshoot and optimize the program if anomalies are detected.

modules.module_title: Load Components and Operate the Machine for PCB Assembly

pcs.pc_description: Set up and configure pick-and-place machines using automated feeder calibration, vision alignment systems, and touchscreen HMIs for precise PCB assembly operations
Operate high-speed SMT lines equipped with AI-driven component placement, real-time monitoring, and defect detection systems to ensure efficient and accurate production
Adjust PCB transport rails for all machines
Check the PCB and components received from the screen-printing section before assembly
Visually inspect the solder paste before initiating the pick-and-place operation.
Verify that all components are correctly placed as per design specifications

modules.module_title: Perform Preventive Maintenance of the Machine

pcs.pc_description: Perform periodic greasing and nozzle cleaning
Maintain the machine regularly to avoid downtime
Ensure that correct components are placed on PCBs to prevent damage to the machine
Keep component reels in designated storage after use to maintain safety
Follow industry standards and compliance guidelines for zero-defect assembly
Use appropriate PPE such as ESD wrist straps, gloves, and goggles during machine operation
Follow ESD precautions to protect components from electrostatic damage
Report any machine faults or safety hazards to the supervisor promptly.
Keep the workstation clean and tools organized to avoid accidents.
Handle and dispose of materials like solder paste safely as per guidelines
